name: Mystic Ward
summary: Faith and arcane study share Ironforge's Mystic Ward, a quieter quarter of the city. Pale blue banners mark its halls, and priests, paladins, and mages gather beneath stone arches in the Hall of Mysteries.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of Faith and Sorcery
sections.body: The Mystic Ward is where Ironforge turns to faith and learning. Pale blue banners mark the quarter between the Commons, the Forlorn Cavern, and the Great Forge. Shops such as The Fighting Wizard and Maeva's Mystical Apparel supply scholars and spellweavers with regalia, scrolls, and alchemical reagents. At the Hall of Mysteries, followers of the Holy Light and arcane practitioners find guidance in wielding unseen powers to defend the Alliance.

faq.q: What is the Mystic Ward used for?
faq.answer: The Mystic Ward brings arcane study and spiritual worship together in Ironforge. Its shops supply spellcasters, while the Hall of Mysteries guides paladins, priests, and mages.

faq.q: What is the main building in the Mystic Ward?
faq.answer: The Hall of Mysteries is the Mystic Ward's main building. Its vaulted chamber houses trainers of holy and arcane spellcasters, with a prominent ornamental pool.

faq.q: Why are the banners in this ward pale blue?
faq.answer: The Mystic Ward's pale blue banners mark its focus on contemplation, wisdom, and magical study. Ironforge's other districts use different heraldry: martial red in the Military Ward and fiery orange at the Great Forge.

faq.q: Where does the Mystic Ward lead?
aliases: how to get to mystic ward
faq.answer: The Mystic Ward lies in Ironforge's northwest. Passages lead south to the Commons, southeast to the Great Forge, and east into the Forlorn Cavern.

angles.text: As an Alliance spellweaver, you can find arcane supplies, spell tomes, and advanced study in the Mystic Ward, Khaz Modan's foremost center outside Stormwind's academies.
As a priest, you can find a peaceful haven in the Mystic Ward and its Hall of Mysteries. Dwarven and visiting followers of the Holy Light gather there for prayer, guidance, and communion.
